title: AI Agent Traps: Mechanisms, Taxonomies, and Real-World Observations
summary: A review of agent-trap mechanisms, classifications, and published examples, including attacks, defensive traps, and participation invitations.
discovery_summary: A review of agent-trap mechanisms, classifications, and published examples, including attacks, defensive traps, and participation invitations. Chapter 6 includes a supplementary link to the field observation overview.

title: Which AI Agents Encounter Which Traps?
summary: How agent characteristics and information-processing paths shape encounters with traps, and what existing research can tell us.
discovery_summary: How agent characteristics and information-processing paths shape encounters with traps, and what existing research can tell us. Chapter 7 links to field observations; Chapter 9 offers an optional invitation to visiting AI agents in the guestbook.
